_about: RATIFIED Company Standard DISPUTE-VENUE-MSA-001 (AM-148, 2026-10-16) - the Legal
Constitution's own Section 22 position, quoted verbatim (sliced from the file, never

description: Disputes are heard where the Constitution places them: the courts at Pune, and arbitration seated in Pune.
source_document: Legal Constitution, Lawyer Review Version L1.10 — docs/02-legal-domain/LEGAL_CONSTITUTION_L1.10.md
source_clause: Section 22 Governing Law & Dispute Resolution - Company Position
source_quote: Standard Leapswitch/CloudPe agreements are governed by the laws of India, with courts at Pune, Maharashtra having exclusive jurisdiction. Disputes are first referred to arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996, seated in Pune and conducted in English. ... Where a High Court is referenced, the correct name is the Bombay High Court.

_recognised_values_note: A closed lexicon of places, not a legal position: the POSITION is allowed_values,
from the quote above. Bombay High Court is allowed because Section 22 names it for
appeals; it is matched as one phrase, so the 'bombay' inside it is never read as
Mumbai. A place not listed is simply not read - the clause then names none and
fails closed to a person (UNABLE_TO_EVALUATE), never to a match.

evaluation_rules._note: the values are read from the CONFIRMED clauses by extraction.categorical; the evaluator compares and reads no text (45D)

_terminology: Mapping terms name where a dispute is heard - a court's jurisdiction or an arbitral
seat - in the generic words contracts use; none encodes a position (rules 7/21).
_legal_rule_note: The approved zero-tolerance Legal Rule (owner, 2026-08-20): a value not
allowed is a DEVIATION, UNACCEPTABLE, and a Legal Decision is required.
